purpose: Teach: 末端/因子/ますれ/買い上げ/係数/番外/不振/とりあげ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 末端の声を経営に届けましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we're bringing the voices from the ground level to the management table.
lines.style: Purposeful and measured. Open clearly on 'Let's.' Steady tone that carries quiet authority without pushiness. Slight forward lean in the cadence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。成功因子の整理表を作ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll put together a summary table of the success factors.
lines.style: Eager, responsive. Bright acknowledgment on 'Yes.' Quick, efficient pace. The tone of someone ready to move and make it happen.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ご質問ますれば、お受け致します
lines.en: If you have any questions, I'm ready to take them.
lines.style: Professional openness. Calm, inviting tone without being casual. Slight pause after 'any questions' — creating space for response. Confident but not closing the door.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法人買い上げのプランを設計します
lines.en: Yes. I'll design a plan for the corporate purchase strategy.
lines.style: Affirmative and detail-focused. Crisp 'Yes.' Warm undertone showing competence. Medium pace, purposeful — someone thinking through the steps as they speak.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 成長係数を上方修正しましょう
lines.en: Let's revise the growth coefficient upward.
lines.style: Decisive, slightly optimistic edge. Open with quiet conviction on the first word. Steady, confident pace. The tone of someone seeing opportunity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。番外編のキャンペーンも企画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll also plan a campaign around the supplementary content.
lines.style: Responsive and inclusive. Warm 'Yes.' Slight lift on 'also' — showing additional initiative. Even pace, conscientious. The tone of someone going the extra step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 不振エリアに集中対策をしましょう
lines.en: Let's concentrate our efforts on the underperforming regions.
lines.style: Serious, solution-focused. Clear attack on the opening. Steady, grounded tone. No rush, but purposeful — the weight of tactical thinking behind each word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。雑誌にとりあげていただけるよう発信します
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure we get coverage in the magazines.
lines.style: Concluding affirmation. Solid 'Yes' — confident without being brash. Slightly faster pace showing momentum. Warm, capable tone that lands decisively.
